walkthrough: Identify the true value $50.0\text{ cm}$ and the two results: X is $(49.5 \pm 0.5)\text{ cm}$ and Y is $(51.4 \pm 0.1)\text{ cm}$.
Judge accuracy by distance from the true value: for X, $|49.5 - 50.0| = 0.5\text{ cm}$, and for Y, $|51.4 - 50.0| = 1.4\text{ cm}$.
Since $0.5\text{ cm} < 1.4\text{ cm}$, the central value of X is closer to the true width, so X is more accurate than Y.
Judge precision by the size of the stated absolute uncertainty: X has $\pm 0.5\text{ cm}$ and Y has $\pm 0.1\text{ cm}$.
Since $0.5\text{ cm} > 0.1\text{ cm}$, X has the larger uncertainty and is therefore less precise than Y.
